```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(car)
```

```{r}
zf <- read_csv("../Data/VOX_ZF.csv")

zf <- zf %>%
  clean_names()

str(zf)
```

Selecting only transgenics
```{r}
zf_transgene <- zf %>%
  filter(transgene_y_n == "Y")
```


```{r}

gfp_mean <- zf_transgene %>%
  select(
    concentration_ug_l,
    contains("mean_gfp_469_525")
  )
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

zf_long <- gfp_mean %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("x"),
    names_to = "day",
    values_to = "gfp_mean"
  )

zf_long <- zf_long %>%
  mutate(
    day = as.numeric(gsub("x|dpf_mean_gfp_469_525", "", day))
  )
```
